parameters.name: Algorithm
parameters.description:
The vector index algorithm.

Valid values:

- `hnswflat`: (Default) An HNSW index without quantization compression.

- `novam`: A graph index without quantization compression. This algorithm is suitable for high-performance scenarios, such as real-time recommendations.

- `novad`: A partitioned index with `rabitq` quantization. This algorithm is suitable for large-scale, low-cost retrieval scenarios.

parameters.name: Collection
parameters.description:
The name of the collection to create.

> The name must comply with PostgreSQL object naming conventions.

parameters.name: DBInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.

> You can call the [DescribeDBInstances](~~86911~~) operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in a specific region.

parameters.name: Dimension
parameters.description:
The vector dimension.

> If you specify this parameter, a vector index is created. In subsequent calls to the [UpsertCollectionData](~~2401493~~) operation, the length of `Rows.Vector` must match this dimension. If you do not specify this parameter, you must call the [CreateVectorIndex](~~2401499~~) operation to create an index later.

parameters.name: ExternalStorage
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to use `mmap` to build the HNSW index. The default value is 0. We recommend setting this to 1 if your data does not require deletion and you need high-performance data ingestion.

Valid values:

- `0`: (Default) Builds the index by using segmented page storage. This mode can use the `shared_buffer` in PostgreSQL for caching and supports `DELETE` and `UPDATE` operations.

- `1`: Builds the index by using `mmap`. This mode does not support `DELETE` or `UPDATE` operations.

><notice>

The `ExternalStorage` parameter is available only for AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL v6.0 instances and is not supported in v7.0.

></notice>

parameters.name: FullTextRetrievalFields
parameters.description: The fields to use for full-text search. Use commas (`,`) to separate multiple field names. These fields must be keys defined in the `Metadata` parameter.

parameters.name: HnswEfConstruction
parameters.description:
The size of the candidate set for HNSW index construction. The value must be greater than or equal to `2 * HnswM`.

> Value range:
>
> - For AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL V6.0 instances: 40 to 4000.
>
> - For AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL V7.0 instances: 4 to 1000. The default value is 64.

parameters.name: HnswM
parameters.description:
The maximum number of neighbors for the HNSW algorithm. You do not typically need to set this parameter, as the system automatically determines a value based on the vector dimension.

> Value range:
>
> - For AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL V6.0 instances: 1 to 1000.
>
> - For AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL V7.0 instances: 2 to 100. The default value is 16.

> We recommend that you set this parameter based on the vector dimension:
>
> - 16 for dimensions less than or equal to 384.
>
> - 32 for dimensions greater than 384 and less than or equal to 768.
>
> - 64 for dimensions greater than 768 and less than or equal to 1024.
>
> - 128 for dimensions greater than 1024.

parameters.name: ManagerAccount
parameters.description:
The name of the management account that has the `rds_superuser` privilege.

> You can call the [CreateAccount](~~2361789~~) operation to create an account.

parameters.name: ManagerAccountPassword
parameters.description: The password of the management account.

parameters.name: Metadata
parameters.description:
A JSON string that defines the metadata schema as a map. The keys are field names, and the values are their corresponding data types.

> Supported data types
>
> - For a list of supported data types, see [Data types](~~424383~~).
>
> - The `money` data type is not supported.

><warning>

The field names `id`, `vector`, `to_tsvector`, and `source` are reserved and cannot be used.

></warning>

parameters.name: MetadataIndices
parameters.description: The scalar index fields. Separate multiple fields with commas (`,`). The fields must be keys that are defined in `Metadata`.

parameters.name: Metrics
parameters.description:
The distance metric used to build the vector index. Valid values:

- `l2`: Euclidean distance.

- `ip`: dot product.

- `cosine`: cosine similarity.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description:
The namespace.

> You can call the [CreateNamespace](~~2401495~~) operation to create a namespace or the [ListNamespaces](~~2401502~~) operation to list existing namespaces.

parameters.name: Parser
parameters.description: The parser for full-text search. The default is `zh_cn`.

parameters.name: PqEnable
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable Product Quantization (PQ) for index acceleration. This is recommended for datasets with more than 500,000 entries. Valid values:

- `0`: Disabled.

- `1`: (Default) Enabled.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The ID of the region where the instance is located.

parameters.name: SparseVectorIndexConfig
parameters.description: The configuration for the sparse vector index. If specified, a sparse vector index is created.

parameters.name: SupportSparse
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable support for sparse vectors. The default value is `false`.

parameters.name: VectorIndexConfig
parameters.description: The configuration for the dense vector index.

parameters.name: WorkspaceId
parameters.description: The ID of the workspace, which contains multiple database instances. You must specify either `WorkspaceId` or `DBInstanceId`. If both are specified, `WorkspaceId` takes precedence.
